mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.code, i.name, i.description, i.category, i.rarity, i.price, i.discount_rate, i.image_url, i.status, i.sort_order, i.created_at, i.updated_at, (inv.id IS NOT NULL) AS owned FROM shop_items i LEFT JOIN user_inventory_items inv ON inv.item_id = i.id AND inv.user_id = #{userId} WHERE (#{category} IS NULL OR i.category = #{category}) AND (#{rarity} IS NULL OR i.rarity = #{rarity}) ORDER BY i.sort_order ASC, i.id ASC

SELECT i.id, i.code, i.name, i.description, i.category, i.rarity, i.price, i.discount_rate, i.image_url, i.status, i.sort_order, i.created_at, i.updated_at, TRUE AS owned FROM user_inventory_items inv JOIN shop_items i ON i.id = inv.item_id WHERE inv.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY inv.purchased_at DESC
SELECT id, code, name, description, category, rarity, price, discount_rate, image_url, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at, FALSE AS owned FROM shop_items WHERE id = #{itemId}
SELECT user_id, balance FROM user_wallets WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT user_id, balance FROM user_wallets WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_wallets (user_id, balance) VALUES (#{userId}, #{balance})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_wallets SET balance = #{balance} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_inventory_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND item_id = #{itemId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_inventory_items (user_id, item_id, paid_price) VALUES (#{userId}, #{itemId}, #{paidPrice})
INSERT INTO wallet_transactions (user_id, reason, amount, balance_after, reference_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{reason}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{referenceId})
